messages:
Maria CSE: FoxRun opened a ticket — sharp p99 spikes on /v1/chat generate starting ~03:20 UTC. p50 ~60ms, p95 ~220ms, p99 ~1.8s. They believe it started after last weekend's routing tweak. Can someone pull allocation + shard logs?

Ava (support): On it. Quick check: foxrun is currently pinned to shard-7 in us-west-2. Rebalancer moved several heavy tenants onto shard-7 yesterday afternoon.

Liam (oncall): I see high queue depth on host gpu-7-2 (shard-7). Queue depth pegs right before the p99 spikes. Also seeing a handful of 504s from the customer side.

Maria CSE: Customer traces attached in the ticket (redacted). Trace IDs: tx-ff3a, tx-ff4b. They include long context (>2k tokens) cases.

Ethan (platform): Observed metrics: KV cache miss rate on shard-7 jumped to 45% (baseline ~8%). Also CPU steal and context-switch rate increased. Looks like long-sequence traffic is thrashing the prefix/KV cache — noisier than usual.

Ava (support): Hypothesis: noisy neighbor with long-input workloads invalidating prefix cache and increasing per-request processing time. Proposed mitigations: 1) ephemeral reservation for foxrun to dedicated pool, 2) temporary soft allowlist (priority lane) so foxrun doesn't get queued behind noisy tenants, 3) short-term per-tenant burst throttle to cap instantaneous RPS. Which to execute first?

Liam (oncall): Do ephemeral reservation first — lowest risk and fastest to verify. I'll spin up a small reserved capacity in us-west-2 and pin foxrun there. Will also flip a short-lived priority flag.

ops-bot: reservation created: res-foxrun-2432, pool=us-west-2-ded-2, capacity=4xA10G, start=now, ttl=4h

Ava (support): FoxRun ops confirmed they're okay with the reservation. They also requested an allowlist to prevent tenant-level throttles from other infra actions while we monitor. They'll want an ETA to share with their SREs.

Maria CSE: Repro steps I used locally (sanitized):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' \n  -H 'X-Tenant: foxrun' \n  -d '{"model":"x-lr-large","input":"<~2k token prompt>"}'
```
This reproduces the p99 tail in our test harness when pinned to shard-7.

Liam (oncall): After moving foxrun to the reservation: p99 dropped to ~240ms within 10 minutes and queue depth normalized. Cache hit rate warmed from 12% -> 32% over 15m. Will keep reservation until midnight PT then re-evaluate after rebalancer cool-down.

Ethan (platform): Long-term action items: implement shard-aware routing by token-length histogram, add per-tenant KV cache budget to prevent cross-tenant pollution, and add a soft isolation mode for long-sequence workloads. Filed infra ticket INF-3291.

Maria CSE: I'll update the FoxRun case with the mitigation, expected timeline, and next steps. FoxRun asked for a short summary they can share with their SREs — I'll send once we confirm stable p99 for 2h. Thanks everyone :pray:

Ava (support): Noted. Monitoring dashboard link: https://console.redwood.ai/d/alerts/shard-7 (shared with foxrun ops). Ping me if p99 creeps back up. :thumbsup:
